newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil raises 195.2 mln reais in Cemig stock sale.
newsitem.headline: Brazil raises 195.2 mln reais in Cemig stock sale.

text.p: Brazil raised 195.2 million reais with the sale of 4.252 billion preferred shares of Minas Gerais state power utility Cemig, stock exchange officials said.
The stock was sold at the minimum price of 46.06 reais per lot of 1,000 shares at an auction at the Minas, Espirito Santo and Brasilia bourse, they said.
Minas Gerais state government sold 4.2 billion shares, representing a 3.23 percent preferred stake in Cemig. The remainder was sold by several brokerage houses.
Private bank Bozano Simonsen acquired the biggest lot of 1.7 billion shares.
This auction precedes a closely watched sale of a 32.9 percent stake in Cemig on April 25 to a strategic partner.
